description: DES MOINES — The state's share — roughly $126 million — of a national settlement with the social media giant Meta over the harms of social media to teenagers will be used to establish payments for Iowa teens, help the state prosecute consumer protection laws, and put more law enforcement officers in schools, Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird announced Monday.…
